messages:
noah_finance: FYI Aurelia Systems reported their April invoice is showing the support plan line as $0.00 and they received two different PDFs with the same invoice number (INV-2024-04-1024). Can someone triage?

lina_billing: Looking. I see invoice record present with invoice_total=USD 18,752.00 but the exported PDF A has total USD 18,752.00 and PDF B has USD 17,502.00. The missing line in B is 'premium-support-plan'.

billing-bot: invoice_export: warning invoice_id=INV-2024-04-1024 export_attempt=2 checksum_mismatch=true partial_export=true

ops-jen: Pulled the invoice rows: support_plan_charge is in line_items table for invoice_id but when renderer ran it pulled pricing from pricing_snapshot where experiment_flag=beta_support_pricing. That snapshot had price_override=0.00 for that SKU.

sre-ryan: Hmm: there was a pricing-experiment rollout yesterday at 03:00 UTC. The experiment service returned a zeroed override for a subset of tenants when the cache warmup failed. That could explain the $0 line.

lina_billing: How did we get two PDFs? export service retries on timeout; it uses a background job that wasn't idempotent. The first export (attempt=1) produced PDF A, the retry (attempt=2) re-rendered with the wrong pricing snapshot and produced PDF B, both were archived.

tara_cs: Customer says one of the PDFs was used for their AP payment. They stopped the second payment, but want confirmation they won't be billed incorrectly.

noah_finance: Priority: confirm which PDF was sent to payment processor and whether a charge already happened. Lina, can you check payment_status?

lina_billing: Checking Stripe logs: invoice INV-2024-04-1024 had a single charge id=ch_3JxYkR captured for USD 18,752.00 at 2024-04-02T09:14:22Z. So payment used the correct amount. The $17,502.00 PDF did not trigger charge.

ops-jen: Actionable root causes: (1) pricing-experiment service returned price_override=0.00 when cache fallback happened, (2) invoice export retries are not idempotent and may re-render with different snapshots.

sre-ryan: Quick mitigation: revert the experiment rollout and pin invoice renderer to use the pricing_snapshot_id embedded in invoice metadata at creation time. Patch ready.

lina_billing: Created FIN-4899 "pricing-experiment cache fallback causes zeroed support line + non-idempotent export leads to duplicate PDFs". Assigning to billing-engine + experiments team.

tara_cs: I'll tell Aurelia: payment completed for full amount, we're sending corrected PDF and an explanation. Please include a note that no duplicate charge occurred and apologize for confusion.

noah_finance: Also need a small internal credit for inconvenience if they request it. Finance to approve on case-by-case.

ops-jen: Temporary stopgap: set export_retry_policy=manual for invoices created between 2024-04-02T09:00:00Z and 2024-04-02T09:30:00Z. Running query to find affected invoices: ``select invoice_id, tenant_id, exported_at, export_attempts from invoice_exports where created_at between '2024-04-02T09:00:00Z' and '2024-04-02T09:30:00Z' and export_attempts>1;``

sre-ryan: Deploying patch to renderer now (target 11:00 UTC). Patch notes: ensure renderer reads price_snapshot_id from invoice metadata; export job marks export_attempts atomically.

lina_billing: I've voided extra archive for INV-2024-04-1024 and removed second PDF from public bucket.

tara_cs: I'll send customer a corrected single-PDF invoice and copy finance. Also asking if they want the complimentary 5% goodwill credit.

noah_finance: Approve up to USD 100 credit without exec signoff. If they request more, escalate.

billing-bot: deploy: renderer v2.5.1-hotfix scheduled for 11:00 UTC. Changes: fix(export): idempotent export marking; fix(renderer): honor invoice.price_snapshot_id during render

ops-jen: Will follow up with postmortem and list of affected customers. Early estimate: ~12 invoices affected across two tenants.

tara_cs: Thanks all. Customer is satisfied that payment was for correct amount, will wait for final note. :thumbsup:
